GRADE 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Healing of Blind Bartimaeus at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
   B. Learners should ignore Healing of Blind Bartimaeus completely.
   C. Healing of Blind Bartimaeus is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing of Blind Bartimaeus.

2. About Healing of Blind Bartimaeus at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives,
   B. Learners should ignore Healing of Blind Bartimaeus completely.
   C. Healing of Blind Bartimaeus is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing of Blind Bartimaeus.

3. About Healing of Blind Bartimaeus when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
   B. Learners should ignore Healing of Blind Bartimaeus completely.
   C. Healing of Blind Bartimaeus is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing of Blind Bartimaeus.

5. About Healing at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
   B. Learners should ignore Healing completely.
   C. Healing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing.

6. About Healing at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives,
   B. Learners should ignore Healing completely.
   C. Healing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing.

7. About Healing when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
   B. Learners should ignore Healing completely.
   C. Healing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing.

9. About Healing By the end of the sub at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Healing By the end of the sub using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing By the end of the sub completely.
   C. Healing By the end of the sub is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing By the end of the sub.

10. About Healing By the end of the sub at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Healing By the end of the sub at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing By the end of the sub completely.
   C. Healing By the end of the sub is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing By the end of the sub.

11. About Healing By the end of the sub when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Healing By the end of the sub helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing By the end of the sub completely.
   C. Healing By the end of the sub is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing By the end of the sub.

13. About Jesus raises a Widow’s Son at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the story of raising the widow’s son,
   B. Learners should ignore Jesus raises a Widow’s Son completely.
   C. Jesus raises a Widow’s Son is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Jesus raises a Widow’s Son.

14. About Jesus raises a Widow’s Son at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise God’s power over life and death,
   B. Learners should ignore Jesus raises a Widow’s Son completely.
   C. Jesus raises a Widow’s Son is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Jesus raises a Widow’s Son.

15. About Jesus raises a Widow’s Son when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. apply lessons learnt by showing compassion to others,
   B. Learners should ignore Jesus raises a Widow’s Son completely.
   C. Jesus raises a Widow’s Son is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Jesus raises a Widow’s Son.

17. About Forgiveness at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the importance of forgiving others,
   B. Learners should ignore Forgiveness completely.
   C. Forgiveness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Forgiveness.

18. About Forgiveness at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. resist vengeance as outlined in Mathew 5:39,
   B. Learners should ignore Forgiveness completely.
   C. Forgiveness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Forgiveness.

19. About Forgiveness when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the importance of forgiving others,
   B. Learners should ignore Forgiveness completely.
   C. Forgiveness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Forgiveness.

21. About Helping the Needy at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. state the importance of helping the needy,
   B. Learners should ignore Helping the Needy completely.
   C. Helping the Needy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Helping the Needy.

22. About Helping the Needy at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate kindness by sharing with those in need,
   B. Learners should ignore Helping the Needy completely.
   C. Helping the Needy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Helping the Needy.

23. About Helping the Needy when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. state the importance of helping the needy,
   B. Learners should ignore Helping the Needy completely.
   C. Helping the Needy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Helping the Needy.

25. About Parable of the lost coin at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the parable of the lost coin,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable of the lost coin completely.
   C. Parable of the lost coin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable of the lost coin.

26. About Parable of the lost coin at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. list lessons learnt from the parable of the lost coin,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable of the lost coin completely.
   C. Parable of the lost coin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable of the lost coin.

27. About Parable of the lost coin when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable of the lost coin completely.
   C. Parable of the lost coin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable of the lost coin.

29. About Parable of the mustard seed at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable of the mustard seed completely.
   C. Parable of the mustard seed is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable of the mustard seed.

30. About Parable of the mustard seed at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable of the mustard seed completely.
   C. Parable of the mustard seed is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable of the mustard seed.

31. About Parable of the mustard seed when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable of the mustard seed completely.
   C. Parable of the mustard seed is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable of the mustard seed.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Healing of Blind Bartimaeus at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Healing at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Healing By the end of the sub at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Jesus raises a Widow’s Son at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Forgiveness at home with your family.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Helping the Needy at home with your family.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Parable of the lost coin at home with your family.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Parable of the mustard seed at home with your family.
